nd_lad.title: News desert supplementary data: districts (England)
nd_lad.snippet: Deprivation, Census 2021, population change, civic life, GE 2024 turnout, business and digital connectivity for England's 296 local authority districts (May 2025).
nd_lad.description:
Supplementary data for the news desert programme. England only. Data build v1.0.0.

GE 2024 turnout is published for constituencies, which don't nest in districts. ge24_turnout_est weights each LSOA's constituency turnout by its residents aged 16+ (Census 2021) and averages to the district. Treat it as an estimate.

Community and Engagement Survey figures have wide confidence intervals at district level; use the _sig fields (above / in line with / below England) for comparisons.

nd_lsoa.title: News desert supplementary data: neighbourhoods (LSOA 2021, England)
nd_lsoa.snippet: Deprivation, Census 2021, rurality, broadband and GE 2024 constituency turnout for England's 33,755 Lower layer Super Output Areas.
nd_lsoa.description:
Supplementary data for the news desert programme. England only. Data build v1.0.0.

LSOA boundaries are ONS full-resolution (BFE V10) generalised server-side to about 15 m. ge24_turnout_pcon is the turnout of the constituency each LSOA best fits; it is not measured for the LSOA.
